name: ISPO Impact Foundation grants
summary: Annual grants in four sizes (micro to impact) for non-profit organisations, clubs and teams. One of two funding categories covers nature conservation and environmental stewardship connected to sport and outdoor recreation; the other covers inclusive participation.

amount.note: Four tiers: micro up to 2,000, seed up to 10,000, momentum up to 30,000, impact up to 100,000

status.quote: We are no longer accepting applications for 2026.

opens.quote: We will be accepting applications from 1-30 June 2026.

deadline.quote: We will be accepting applications from 1-30 June 2026.

applicant_types.quote: We can only accept applications from registered non-profit organisations, clubs and teams.

geography.quote: We will accept applications from any every geographical region.

access.quote: If you wish to apply for any of the grants, please read the guidance notes carefully

window.quote: Sign up to our newsletter to be the first to know when our 2027 funding round will take place.

amount.quote: up to €100 000 Impact Grant Supporting transformative initiatives with potential for significant / global impact.
